verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents support for over 400 TLDs on a dedicated top-level-domains page, and the community confirms some extensions such as .app, so the breadth half of the story is met. Users also report specific gaps: no .us at the time of an older thread, and no IDN domains. Nothing in the pack shows per-TLD documentation of special requirements for restricted or country-code TLDs. Missing for 10: per-TLD documentation of restricted/ccTLD requirements, evidence of coverage for country codes like .us, IDN support, and independent confirmation of the current TLD list.
